firstScreen.notes: DOM: h1 6 words with trade+city. Phone in header and mobile bar. Primary+secondary CTA distinct. Proof line with sample price, hours, sample-tagged rating. Hero min-height calc(100svh-header) so next band peeks. Cannot verify intro timing or filmstrip swipe without screenshots; single frame in DOM.

distinctiveness.notes: Grit Sequence Rail in hero (36), story (60·100·STAIN), proof (COAT 1·2·3), footer (FINISH) — 4 sections. Grit pills in reviews. Noise overlay. Palette Raw Maple/Walnut/Amber. Type pair Crimson Pro+Karla+DM Mono. 9+ layout families. No sibling screenshots but concept.json confirms differentiation.

type.notes: Crimson Pro display, Karla text, DM Mono accent. Fluid clamp scale. Body >=1rem. Lead uses opsz variation. Tabular nums on prices/rating. Kicker tracked caps. H1 tracking -.03em. En-dash in price range. No orphans. Sample tags consistent.

layout.notes: Tones alternate paper/deep/cream/deep/paper/cream/deep/accent/paper/cream/deep. No two dark bands touch. Full-bleed break. Asymmetric splits. Pinned story >=640px. Dense services grid. Quiet CTA strip. Section gaps > internal gaps.

copy.notes: Trade-specific nouns. No banned phrases. Buttons named for action. Sample labels on rating/reviews/pricing/guarantee/licence. Hours shown. One em dash. -0.5: primary action inconsistent (Book vs Schedule a sample visit).

mobile.notes: CSS: mobile bar <=899px with phone+CTA. Tap targets >=48px. No horizontal scroll. Story pinned only >=640px. H1 clamp <=4 lines at 390. Full-screen menu. Cannot verify rendering without screenshots; CSS composition correct.

a11y.notes: Skip link. Focus 3px solid var(--focus). All inputs labelled. Honeypot hidden. ARIA live on ZIP/checklist/estimator. Reduced motion shows all content. JS-off hides controls, content visible. Heading order correct. Stars aria-label. Grit rails aria-hidden.

motion.notes: Hooks: reveal, reveal-stagger, reveal-clip, carousel, story, checklist, estimator, zip, menu (>=3 beyond plain reveals). Reduced motion respected. Pinned story >=640px. Lenis loaded, no scroll-jacking. Cannot verify easing/timing/intro without screenshots.

wow.notes: Grit rail + pinned story crossfade tied to thesis. Estimator SVG sketch. Checklist instant diagnosis. Tool output with tabular nums and print button. Cannot verify visual impact without screenshots.

polish.notes: SVG favicon + apple-touch-icon. OG 1200x630. JSON-LD HomeAndConstructionBusiness. Print stylesheet. Lazy images with dimensions. Hero preloaded. Forced colors. Consistent 2px radius. No transition:all. Credits links missing href (warning, not blocker).

elevate.move: Tie the grit rail --sw-p clip-path wipe to scroll progress via ScrollTrigger so the signature animates continuously as the visitor scrolls, making the grit progression feel like a real sanding pass.
Animate the estimator SVG sketch fill opacity and size proportionally to the slider value in real time, turning the numeric output into a spatial feeling as the homeowner drags.
